note: Approvals of the Wave 4 §15.3 golden captures. An entry {"file", "sha256"} approves one capture file at one SHA-256, written "sha256:<hex>" exactly as the visual suite writes it into captures.json and qualify:wave4 into the manifest; qualify:wave4 reports any other capture as pending or changed. A person approves a capture in a reviewed change, or an agent does on the owner's explicit delegation, recorded in that change; CI never approves.
